purpose: Post-hoc arithmetic attribution, conditional direction diagnostics, and prospective protocol draft; no fitting or tuning
paired_control: Train-only per-asset majority matching the EVALUATED truth; raw truth majority recomputed on the same mature training indices, never on test
attribution: Exact difference in correct predictions by actual down/neutral/up state; wins-losses contingency; leave-one-asset and leave-one-calendar-block out
direction_probability: p_up/(p_down+p_up), evaluated on ALL actual moves for the declared truth, even if the original three-class prediction is neutral; conditional diagnostic, not replacement full-coverage accuracy
direction_control: Per-asset train-only Laplace direction prior matching evaluated truth, common to all four learned methods; raw sign uses matured raw training outcomes
confidence_policy: Fixed descriptive strata only; no thresholds selected, no modified forecasts or abstention policy
bootstrap: Reuse both parent 13-day/3-calendar-day-block banks; marginal intervals only, no new significance gate

duration_planning.warning: Only four full observed 3-day blocks. Normal power and chi-square variance approximations assume independent stationary blocks, not established here; scenarios not a certified sample-size calculation or approved effect target.

future_draft.symbol_policy: All eight original assets; no October winner selection
